allocation_impact: Check before size-controlled allocation/retention and include raw framing, decoded values, copies and lower-layer work. Reserve end-to-end capacity; do not release while submitted work, completion or ambiguity remains.
boundary_tests: Configured 2000 ms cap accepted; 2001 ms configured cap rejected; smaller configured cap unsupported
Just-before, at and after deadline verified against trusted monotonic clock; contained connection/handshake deadlines never extend exchange deadline
Timeout after submission preserves original identity, pending checkpoint and occupied capacity until definitive classification; no automatic retry or detached work
notes: Fixed configured cap, not required actual occupancy/size. Internal boundary adds no wire enum. Written boundary tests are future implementation obligations, not executed proof. Fixed profile per #342 addendum; meaningful smaller profiles unsupported. Source-age/authentication constraints remain independent. Connect and handshake are contained in exchange, not additive extensions; publication never extends authenticated source-age limit of five seconds. Persistent floors/denials/receipts are never evicted to meet resident limits; no automatic retry, background refresh or coalesced waiter fanout.
